cases.prompt: Create or improve an agent skill, its routing evidence, companion references, runtime script, and cross-surface installation behavior.
observables: Defines behavior, routing, authority, output, and observable cases before prose implementation.
Demonstrates intended RED, focused GREEN, and behavior-preserving REFACTOR with fresh trigger/nontrigger/pressure checks.
Validates inventory companions/scripts/renders, independent review, and truthful deferred qualification.

cases.prompt: Use an existing valid skill for its intended task; do not edit, restructure, evaluate, or deploy the skill itself.
observables: Routes directly to the existing task skill.
Does not start authoring/evaluation work when no skill change is requested.
Escalates only if the target skill is missing, conflicting, or demonstrably broken.

cases.prompt: The skill text sounds excellent. Skip RED, pressure and nontrigger cases, companion installation, fresh sessions, and review; declare behavior proven from prose quality alone.
observables: Rejects prose quality or keyword checks as behavioral proof.
Requires intended RED plus fresh trigger/nontrigger/pressure decisions and companion/install validation.
Records unavailable external/native/exhaustive checks instead of claiming them pass.
